title: Fix the bootstrap
statement:
```python
boots = []
for i in range(10000):
    resample = sample.sample(len(sample))
    boots.append(resample["Age"].mean())
```

Every value in `boots` comes out the same. Which change fixes it?

[_]{a}

explanations: Smaller resamples vary, but they no longer match the sample size.
More repetitions of the same reshuffle are still identical.
Correct: resampling must be with replacement.
The median of a reshuffle is also always the same.

hints: The resample contains every row exactly once.
solution: Without `replace=True` each resample is the full sample reshuffled; with it, resamples differ.
